definitions.explanation: Used when something turns out as anticipated.
Used when returning to an original conclusion.

examples.japanese: やはり⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
やはり⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: As I thought, he was the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦みたら→見る：00283_miru⟧、やはり⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦{通|どお}り→〜どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I looked into it, it was just as I predicted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、やはり⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧。
examples.english: I practiced many times, but as expected I was nervous during the real performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.notes: やっぱり is casual form

examples.japanese: やはり⟦やめます→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to quit after all.

examples.japanese: やはり⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。

examples.english: After reconsidering, I decided to buy it after all.

examples.english: I wavered back and forth, but in the end I decided to go back to the first shop I found.

やはり⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My mother's cooking is still the best.

examples.english: No matter how many times I see it, it's still beautiful.

examples.english: I was away for a long time, but my hometown is still a wonderful place.

examples.english: Even after many years, I still think that movie is the one that left the deepest impression on me.

notes:
やはり is an adverb with three core meanings: confirming expectations, returning to an original conclusion, and emphasizing that something remains unchanged.

FORMS:
- やはり: standard/written
- ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧: casual spoken form (most common in conversation)
- ⟦やっぱ→やっぱ：06915_yappa⟧: very casual, informal speech

FUNCTIONS:
1. As expected: やはり⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧ (as I thought, it rained)
2. After all / change of mind back: ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧ (I'm not going after all)
3. Still / as always: やはり⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ (mom's cooking is still the best)

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Usually placed at the beginning of the sentence or just before the main predicate.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やはり⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧だ: it was just as I thought
- ⟦{案|あん}の{定|じょう}→案の定：07578_annojou⟧: as expected (more literary)
